researchSummary: Nine verified survivors plus SPY at 9.5% as a residual. Weight tilts to MSFT (the only buy-rated name, best entry in the cohort, +32% net income) and META, with every other incumbent kept near its current weight. The megacap-tech/AI cluster is 40.5% (MSFT 20.5, META 13, AAPL 7), under the 48% cap. Payments V+MA are 19.5%, under 20%. The defensive total is about 12% by this allocation (PEP 6, COST 6), plus the retained KO phase-out. It is measured, not mandated: both names are in on their composite and neither is ballast, and LLY is excluded from the defensive count by its wide range. No held name is dropped for a broken thesis. KO, NEM and UNP, plus the VTI parking vehicle, were simply not among this cycle's verified survivors. They are left to the two-strike phase-out and churn governor rather than force-sold, and UNP is on its second consecutive miss. NVDA, AMZN, GOOGL and CAT are not held, so omitting them costs nothing. Weights are conviction-first and then scaled by the cohort-relative entry haircut. MSFT and META get the largest slots (best relative entries, 1.12 and 1.09). LLY, COST and AAPL are sized down (0.91, 0.88, 0.91) with zones set near spot. V and COST have thin or poor reward:risk at spot, so their slots stay small and are not cut to cash.
